newsitem.title: UK: GOLF-BURTON PRACTISES AFTER INJURY SCARE.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-BURTON PRACTISES AFTER INJURY SCARE.

text.p: U.S. Solheim Cup player Brandie Burton has recovered from a twisted ankle and is expected to be fit for Friday's start of the biennial women's team match against Europe.
Burton, a wild card selection, hurt her right ankle stepping back after hitting a drive at the seventh hole of the St Pierre Course on Tuesday.
She was taken off the course on a buggy with her ankle bandaged and there were fears she had suffered serious injury.
But on Wednesday she practised some shots and then set off for a practice round riding in a buggy as a precaution,
